android.desc:
HAVE FUN DOING PUSH-UPS

Do you want to build muscles and lose weight? Unfortunately, Push-up Game isn't the right app for that. However, if you want to have fun and burn some energy, you're in the right place.

No equipment needed, you can train anytime, anywhere, whether you're at home, in the gym, or outside.

No push-ups, no coins.

No coins, no new characters to play with style.

Join the gamified push-up challenge and unlock all levels before your friends, as well as all the characters inspired by famous internet memes.

Did you enjoy the "Special Forces Challenge" filter on TikTok?
You'll love Push-up Game, the full version of that challenge.

SHARE YOUR SUCCESS

Record your screen and share your run on your favorite social networks!

HOW TO PLAY?

It's very simple: get into a push-up position in front of your smartphone.

Stare at your phone's camera and move your character by doing push-ups until you finish the level. You must absolutely avoid obstacles to avoid losing.
You can also collect coins to unlock new characters.
Perform push-ups on top of enemies' heads to eliminate them with style.

Complete a level with flair by completing all the challenges at once.

Be careful, there's no pause button! So, you'll have to finish the level in one attempt. 
Otherwise, it's back to square one.

VARIED LEVELS

Push-up Game is a mobile game that contains different levels with varying difficulties. Additional challenges are there to turn easy levels into more difficult ones.

CREATE YOUR OWN DIFFICULTY

Do you find a level too hard or too easy?

Change the way you do your push-ups:

Easy level: push-ups on your knees
Normal level: classic push-ups
Very difficult level: diamond push-ups

quotes.text:
I love sport, I love games, so I merged the two and built this mobile game.

I literally have to do real push-ups to move my character and complete the course.

The app is built in Flutter and Flame, and uses Google mlkit object detection.

I'd love to hear your thoughts on the concept.

(Available on iOS too)
